approx_quantiles_probe.sql: SELECT APPROX_QUANTILES(x, 4) AS q FROM UNNEST([1.0, 2.0, 10.0, 100.0, 3.0]) AS x

partition_pruning_dry_run_bytes.note: Dry-run estimates. All data sits in two daily partitions, so a filter inside the busier day prunes nothing and costs the started_at column; a filter that excludes a day prunes it.
